text:
marta_sales: QuantumPay procurement asked for an assurance packet for a 14-day POC. Needs: SOC2 (redacted ok), ISO27001 cert, signed pen-test attestation, short network diagram, and a brief data residency statement. Deadline: Fri COB. Can we deliver?

olivia_sec: Scope? POC tenant only or production coverage? Also: do they need notarized signature or will DocuSign suffice?

marta_sales: They said POC tenant. Notarization is "nice to have" but e-sign is acceptable. They'll note whether they need raw reports or a redacted CVSS summary.

doug_ps: We can assemble the PDFs and a redacted attestation. If they want isolation for scans we can spin up a short-lived dedicated slice; ballpark delta: +$3k for 2 weeks (depends on model size).

trent_ops: For external scans: we require a signed scope form and a maintenance window. We'll provision a presigned S3 path for uploads. Example we give them: `aws s3 cp scan-report.zip "<presigned-url>"`

legal-bot: TASK-8712 created: "quantumpay poc assurance pack" assigned to security/legal/ops. Link: https://issues.redwood.internal/TASK-8712

olivia_sec: Draft attestation snippet we usually provide:

```
Redwood Inference, Inc. attests that third-party penetration testing is conducted at least annually and that scoped testing of staging/dedicated environments is available upon request. As of (DATE), no critical vulnerabilities affecting the scoped POC tenant were outstanding. A redacted summary of the latest external assessment (CVSS buckets only) can be provided under NDA.
```

doug_ps: Pricing note: dedicated slice (A10-equivalent) for 2 weeks ~ +$3k. One-off ops engineering time ~ 3-5 hours. If they require customer-managed KMS or on-prem Private, that's a separate quote.

marta_sales: Action items: (1) Olivia - assemble SOC2 redacted + ISO cert + draft attestation, (2) Doug - confirm final cost delta if isolation requested, (3) Trent - prepare presigned upload and 3 maintenance windows, (4) I'll confirm whether notarization is required or e-sign OK. Target: draft packet by Thu EOD.

olivia_sec: On it, looping legal for attestation signature. Will redline if needed.

trent_ops: I'll post windows and generate a placeholder presigned URL once TASK-8712 is acknowledged.

marta_sales: Thanks team :thumbsup: I told QuantumPay procurement we'll aim for Thu draft so they can review before Fri signature."
